Write a work plan for 25 Juniper modules. Use only these final values; do not invent others.

Values: upload.batch=200,billing.batch=750,quota.batch=900,ledger.batch=450,metrics.queue=270,checkout.ttl=360,alerts.timeout=20,export.batch=350,export.timeout=90,session.batch=250,media.queue=490,gateway.batch=450,search.batch=200,feed.retry=9,sync.retry=8,pricing.retry=6

Workers: media→alpha; ledger,metrics→delta; reports,profile→gamma; alerts,catalog,inventory→beta

Deps (A→B): inventory,checkout,archive→export; returns→pricing; gateway→feed,metrics; shipping→search; pricing→reports

Never (transitive): search→feed; sync→media; session→ledger; archive→ingest

Colocate: ingest+checkout; shipping+upload; archive+scheduler; returns+billing

Split: checkout|sync; export|feed; catalog|shipping; billing|checkout

Order: metrics<reports; feed<scheduler; quota<session; checkout<shipping

Conditions (if⇒then): feed.retry>6⇒shipping.retry≤1; search.batch>100⇒reports.retry≤2; quota.batch>800⇒archive.batch≤200; upload.batch>150⇒ingest.queue≤20; export.batch>250⇒inventory.timeout≥120; ledger.batch>400⇒quota.queue≥500; media.queue>480⇒ingest.batch≥900; checkout.ttl>270⇒catalog.max_workers≤4

Files: core.py→metrics; limits.py→inventory; hooks.py→shipping; fixtures.py→scheduler; adapters.py→returns; specs.py→checkout; worker.py→billing; routes.py→media

Note: several condition keys have no given value (shipping.retry, reports.retry, archive.batch, ingest.queue, inventory.timeout, quota.queue, ingest.batch, catalog.max_workers). Do not invent them; flag them as open. Only 24 modules are named; the 25th and all unassigned items are team's call.
